title: A General Spatio-Temporal Backbone with Scalable Contextual Pattern Bank for Urban Continual Forecasting
methodology: Continual Spatio-Temporal Forecasting, Frequency Domain Representation (FreNet), Dynamic Linear Graph Attention (DLGA), Contextual Pattern Bank
notes: Addresses node expansion and temporal distribution drift in real-world streaming traffic data by freezing a general backbone and incrementally updating a scalable pattern bank.

title: PMDformer: Patch-Mean Decoupling Information Transformer for Long-term Forecasting
methodology: Patch-Mean Decoupling (PMD), Proximal Variable Attention (PVA), Trend Restoration Attention (TRA)
notes: Separates trend and residual shape information by subtracting the patch mean, ensuring attention mechanisms capture true shape similarities.

title: CPiRi: Channel Permutation-Invariant Relational Interaction for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
methodology: Channel Permutation-Invariant (CPI), Spatio-Temporal Decoupling, Permutation-Invariant Regularization
notes: Addresses the channel ordering sensitivity of CD models and the relational reasoning lack of CI models in MTSF.
